profileLabel: Liberal on social values; center-left economics (medium confidence)
summary: Laguna 1st District representative with 110 principal-authored bills. Authored a Magna Carta for LGBTQ+ Filipinos, Family Code equality for men and women, spousal support after void marriages, Safe Spaces Act penalties, a stronger Commission on Women, pay transparency, universal child care support and wiretapping law amendments. Co-authored the national minimum wage.
caveat: Social score is capped at +3 because conduct beyond authored bills was not reviewed; the LGBTQ+ Magna Carta bill alone would support a higher score. Wiretapping amendment direction unreviewed.

economic.label: Center-left
economic.rationale: Authored universal child care support (-3), mandated pay transparency with gender-disaggregated reporting (-2) and GSIS voluntary contribution for non-career workers (-1); co-authored the national minimum wage (-2).
